sara (People Ops): FYI: SF office will be closed Fri Apr 9 for electrical maintenance. Building management requires full floor access shut-down from 9am-3pm. Please don't come onsite during that window unless pre-approved.

leo: Bummer, had a client call at 10. Can we use any rooms before 9?

sara (People Ops): Yes — common areas and Conf B on 7 are fine until 9. After 9 access is limited. If you need a secure space for a client meeting, we can rebook a quiet room on Thurs evening.

anika: I park in Lot D. Will the gates be open?

facilities-team: Lot D accessible but lobby doors will be locked during the work. Park as usual and use the temporary entrance at 5th St (staff will be on site). Shuttle runs 08:30 and 15:15 for anyone who needs it.

leo: Travel change fees? I had a flight arriving Fri morning.

ops-bot: Travel policy: company-directed closures -> change fees reimbursed. See travel page.

sara (People Ops): If you choose to travel anyway standard rules apply. For company-directed changes, submit receipts in Concur and tag nyc-electrical-2026 (or sf-electrical-2026 for SF).

anika: Will mail/packages be affected? I expect a prototyping kit delivery on Fri.

facilities-team: Mailroom open but large deliveries will be held. Tell the sender to deliver Thurs or notify fac-team and we can accept on your behalf.

leo: Any food/coffee? :coffee:

sara (People Ops): We'll have a morning snack box in the lobby Thurs and a coffee cart Fri morning before 9.

anika: Thanks. If I need special badge access who do I contact?

sara (People Ops): DM me. We'll grant limited access only for critical equipment pickup; approvals must go through your manager.

facilities-team: We'll post signage and have folks at the temporary entrance. Expect slight delays during the shutdown window.

sara (People Ops): Final note: if this closure impacts customer-facing demos, tell your AM/AE and ops and we'll prioritize a conference room or remote setup. I'll post an update Thurs afternoon. :white_check_mark:
